about.title: Who's behind this
about.intro: My name is Héctor Jarque. I don't come from an agency or a miracle bootcamp. I learned by doing, breaking and fixing things.
about.learning: I started knowing nothing and gradually trained myself until I could build the websites and projects I create today.
about.honesty: I won't throw jargon at you to impress. If something can't be done, I'll tell you.
about.location: I live in Valencia, Spain. I work remotely, and if you're nearby we can grab a coffee.
